Name: Jack's Assorted Pets
Author: JackR0
Description:
[color=#3c78d8][b]Assorted Pets [/b]by [b]Jack Rivers[/b][/color]

Ever wanted to have mythical creatures as pets in Stardew Valley? Well, now you can!

This mod includes 4 different creatures you can start the game with or adopt from Marnie:

[list]
[*]Drake
[*]Gryphon
[*]Hippocampus
[*]Kitsune
[/list]
[color=#3c78d8][b]---------------------------------------[/b][/color]

[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*][b]SMAPI - and requirements[/b]
[/list] ﻿ Make sure SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) and CP (Content Patcher) are downloaded and up to date!

[b]﻿2. Assorted Pets[/b]
﻿ Install this mod!

[b]﻿3. Mod Folder[/b]
﻿ Unzip Assorted Pets and place it into your mods folder! (It can be in a subfolder if you like to keep things organized.)

[color=#3c78d8][b]---------------------------------------[/b][/color]

It's been a while since I've posted anything, but I wanted to take this project on to challenge myself! I didn't think I'd be able to accomplish making these lil guys, but I did, and it's been so much fun!

The only thing not fully made by me that was used in this mod was the horse part of the Hippocampus and references! (Like copy and pasting horse sprites onto the dog spritesheet lol) Maybe one day I won't need them, but I'm not quite there yet.

As always, if you have any questions, concerns, ideas, etc. please feel free to comment on here or message me!
[b]
[color=#3c78d8]---------------------------------------[/color]
[/b]
